messages:
Maya (AE): FYI prospect says: fully isolated DC, no internet, needs a POC via USB. Primary asks: how we package, delta vs full updates, chain-of-custody for courier, SBOM, and one-off pricing. Can SE/Ops/security chime in?

Jon (SE): We can support. Quick clarifiers: do they run Kubernetes or plain VMs? Which distro & container runtime? Also need to know GPU availability (NVIDIA driver versions) for model selection.

Tara (Ops): For on-prem offline we produce a signed bundle + manifest. Typical sizes: full bundle ~14GB, "minibundle" (runtime + single small model) ~1.8GB. We split into 2GB USB chunks with an index file. Recommend customer-stage host with >=30GB free to unpack and local registry space.

Liam (Security): Important: telemetry must be off by default and any telemetry flags documented. For POC we generally provide a temporary signing key; if they require HSM-based signing we can accommodate but need contract language. Also need to know whether they'll import our CA cert or require signing with their CA.

Evan (AM): Pricing approach: one-time offline packaging fee + transport & handling + optional on-site SE days. Ballpark: $5k packaging + $1.5k/day SE. Can offer reduced pilot pricing if they're strategic.

Jon (SE): Operational playbook (high level):
1) Prospect shares inventory: OS, k8s (yes/no), container runtime, GPU model, disk, IPMI/contact.
2) We build minibundle targeting their platform and chosen model.
3) We sign bundle and produce SHA256 manifest + SPDX SBOM.
4) We chunk into tar.gz.partNN for USB and include install script with --airgap flag.
5) Customer copies, runs installer which verifies signature and loads images to local registry.

Verification commands we provide:
```
sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz > redwood-offline-bundle.sha256
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-bundle.sig redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz
./install.sh --airgap --confirm-checksums
```

Tara (Ops): Upgrade cadence recommendation: for short POC keep delta patches weekly if models change; production we'd propose 3-6 month regular cadence with emergency hotfixes. Note: deltas require identical base image hash; if customer mutates images locally, deltas fail and full replace needed.

Maya (AE): Customer wants SBOM + provenance and a signed manifest for auditors. Can provide?

Liam (Security): Yes — we attach SPDX SBOMs and sign them. We can also add per-artifact hashes and a notarization entry if required. Need SOW to state retention and access for audit.

Evan (AM): Logistics question: who handles chain-of-custody for USBs? We can ship to their logistics team or use their on-prem courier. Ops, any preference?

Tara (Ops): We prefer customer-managed courier for Liabilities reasons. If we ship, Ops will record handoff name, timestamp, and signed receipt. We'll include a chain-of-custody form. Also need contact email + phone at customer for acceptance window.

shipbot: Created ticket INF-4129 "offline-usb-poc-bundle" and added checklist.

Maya (AE): Timeline: they want POC within 10 business days. Is that feasible?

Jon (SE): Yes if we get inventory + model choice within 24 hours. Build/sign ~36 hours. Testing + chunking ~12 hours.

Tara (Ops): Ops can prepare USB images and ship in 48 hours after we have the final signed artifact and courier instructions.

Liam (Security): I'll prepare a short security addendum draft (HSM/key requirements, CA import instructions, telemetry off, SBOM requirements) and drop it here.

Maya (AE): Perfect. I'll collect inventory now and confirm budget for packaging fee. Thanks all :)
